history: a4 = A H x4 (A = 1 canonical), b4 = b4(0) e^{beta A H x4} (beta = 4/3), a4' = A H, b4'/b4 = beta A H; slices a4,0 = a4(x4), b4,0 = b4(0) e^{beta a4,0}; PRESCRIBED BACKGROUND (see historyStatus)
status: PRESCRIBED BACKGROUND: the history a4 = H x4, b4 = b4(0) e^{(4/3) H x4} is prescribed, not solved for. With the author's Lovelock weights the a4 and b4 equations of SPEC section 5 allow it only with the constant source kappa (rho, p3, p_t, p0) = (-2/27, -2/9, -22/27, -14/27) (Revision/field_equations_a4/a4-equations.json, exponentialHistory.authorWeights.historySource); the Kohn-Sham states along it do not supply this source (they depend on x0 and change with a4,0: Revision/field_equations_a4/reports/ks-source-conditions.json). The Kohn-Sham gas is therefore a test field on a prescribed background without back-reaction, and quantities derived along this history (energies, pressures, equations of state) are not consequences of the coupled field equations.
